title: act({ seat }) re-seats the figure every tick: group y offsets are ignored
summary: act({ seat }) re-seats a seated figure every tick, so group y offsets do nothing. Change the seat value (and x/z) instead; scaled figures need it adjusted.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: f.act('Sitting_Talking_Loop', { t: 1.3, seat: .47 })   // seat = the seat top y in the figure's parent space

doc.when: Any seated figure, especially scaled ones or ones inside a scaled group.
doc.avoid: Moving a seated figure's group in y.
gotchas: At 1.2x scale the sit clip puts the hips ~.4 m behind the figure origin: adjust the placement.

problem.symptom: A seated figure floats above or sinks into the seat regardless of y offsets.
problem.cause: act() with seat re-seats the figure each tick.
problem.fix: Change the seat value (and x/z placement), not the group y.
problem.detect: Editing group y has no effect on a seated figure.
